headline: OpenAI releases a claimed AI-generated refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis with Lean formalization
summary: OpenAI reports that an internal model produced a refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH), then released a natural-language manuscript and Lean formalization. The linked Lean scope describes a subexponential exact-counting bound for fixed-k canonical k-CNF formulas; this would contradict ETH only if the formal definitions and scope match the standard conjecture. OpenAI says an external group led by Russell Impagliazzo, Ramamohan Paturi and Ryan Williams will examine the result; their participation is not certification. A community contributor now reports pinned-byte ports of both OpenAI and Anthropic proof chains to a common standard multitape-machine statement, checked by several tools within one Lean environment per chain. The author disclosed Claude-assisted work, four Lean judge checkers reportedly stopped on resource limits for OpenAI’s large export, and the relation to textbook ETH remains interpretive. the research desk did not replay these artifacts; independent review and practical algorithmic impact remain open.
